name: 5-MAPBT
summary: 5-MAPBT, also known as 5-(2-(methylamino)propyl)-1-benzothiophene, is a possible entactogen of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and benzothiophene families. It is closely related to 5-MAPB, but with the oxygen atom replaced by sulfur, changing the core ring structure to benzothiophene rather than benzofuran.

pharmacology.text: The drug acts as a potent monoamine releasing agent, including of serotonin and dopamine, and as a potent serotonin 5-HT1B receptor agonist and serotonin 5-HT2B receptor antagonist. It is also a monoamine oxidase A (MAO-A) inhibitor, with an IC50 of 765 nM.
pharmacology.kind: Monoamine releasing agent; Serotonin 5-HT1B receptor agonist; Entactogen

uses.text: 5-MAPBT has been studied and patented by Matthew J. Baggott at Tactogen.

summaryZh: 5-MAPBT是一種含氮有機硫化合物，化學式C12H15NS，和其類似物5-MAPB都能作為精神藥物，不過苯並呋喃替換為苯並噻吩。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It releases serotonin and also blocks the enzyme MAO-A, a combination that raises the risk of serotonin syndrome and dangerous rises in blood pressure. Entactogens of this kind can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea and a low mood afterwards.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它會釋放血清素，同時抑制酵素MAO-A，這樣的組合會提高血清素症候群與血壓危險升高的風險。這類同理心增強劑可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心，以及藥效過後的情緒低落。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它会释放血清素，同时抑制酵素MAO-A，这样的组合会提高血清素症候群与血压危险升高的风险。这类同理心增强剂可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心，以及药效过后的情绪低落。

fact.en: It is 5-MAPB with the oxygen of the benzofuran ring swapped for sulphur, turning it into a benzothiophene. Sulphur sits directly below oxygen in the periodic table, so it can often take its place.
fact.zh: 它是把5-MAPB苯并呋喃環上的氧換成硫，使它變成苯并噻吩。在週期表上硫就在氧的正下方，因此常常可以取代氧的位置。
fact.zhHans: 它是把5-MAPB苯并呋喃环上的氧换成硫，使它变成苯并噻吩。在周期表上硫就在氧的正下方，因此常常可以取代氧的位置。
